5456904.implementedAlgorithm: digit length from int(log(m,10)), then per-block cost loop

5529580.fault: d = 9*s is computed from the old s before s advances (lines 13-14), so block sizes and s stop being 9*10^(l-1) and 10^l; final s - m + k//l is off
5529580.implementedAlgorithm: w//k digits budget, partial first block, then whole blocks of 9*10^(l-1) numbers

5602633.fault: n = 10*s uses the digit count s instead of 10**s, so the first block boundary is wrong (for m=183 n=30 < m, cost negative)
5602633.implementedAlgorithm: block walk with n as the next block boundary
